#076 · Megaton Pokémon

Golem

Rock Ground

Kanto · Generation 1

Golem is a Rock/Ground-type Megaton Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 300 kg. It evolves from Graveler. Its highest base stat is Defense (130), with a base stat total of 495.
